reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: I’ve been using the SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Foam and it works really well for my skin. It cleanses deeply without making my skin feel tight or dry. The foam feels soft and gentle, but still helps reduce breakouts and smooth out skin texture over time. After washing, my skin feels fresh, clean, and more balanced. A great daily cleanser for acne-prone and sensitive skin.
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊 SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Foam，皮膚用完效果好好。清潔得深入但係唔會令皮膚繃緊或者乾燥。泡泡質感柔軟溫和，但係長遠用可以幫助減少爆瘡同平滑膚質。洗完之後皮膚清爽乾淨，感覺更加平衡。對暗瘡肌同敏感肌嚟講係一款出色嘅日常洗面產品。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: A very good cleansing cream. It cleans the skin thoroughly without drying it out. A small amount is enough, so the product lasts a long time. My son has been using it for several weeks, and his skin looks clearer with fewer breakouts
reviews.zh: 一支好好嘅潔面霜。徹底清潔皮膚但係唔會令皮膚乾。少量就夠，所以好襟用。我個仔用咗幾個禮拜，皮膚望落清咗，爆瘡都少咗。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text:
I purchased **SOME BY MI AHA, BHA, PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam** for my 15-year-old daughter to help with teenage acne. She has been using this line for about six months, and the results are truly impressive. Breakouts have significantly reduced, and her skin looks clearer, more even, and well cared for.

The foam cleanses gently without over-drying or causing irritation, which is especially important for sensitive teenage skin. The acids work effectively yet delicately, gradually improving the overall condition of the skin. A great option for acne-prone skin — effective but still gentle. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh:
我買咗 **SOME BY MI AHA, BHA, PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam** 畀我15歲嘅阿女用，希望幫到佢處理青春期暗瘡。佢用咗呢個系列大約六個月，效果真係好明顯。爆瘡大幅減少，皮膚望落清咗、均勻咗，狀態好好。

泡泡溫和清潔，唔會過度抽乾水分或者引起刺激，對青春期敏感肌嚟講特別重要。呢啲酸類有效得嚟都幾溫和，長遠可以逐漸改善整體膚質。對暗瘡肌嚟講係一個好好嘅選擇——有效但係仍然溫和。極力推薦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: It’s really strong product! I instantly feel the effect of acids. It doesn’t burn, but I feel it somehow. Don’t need other acids, just use it as a mask for 30-60 seconds 😁
reviews.zh: 真係勁嘅產品！即刻就feel到酸類嘅威力。唔會刺，但係感覺到佢喺度做嘢。唔使再用其他酸類，淨係當mask用30至60秒就得 😁

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: This is my 3rd time buying this product from SOME BY MI. It works really well for my skin by gently exfoliating and keeping my pores clear. I love how smooth and clean my skin feels after using it. I’m very satisfied and will keep repurchasing it.
reviews.zh: 呢個已經係我第三次回購 SOME BY MI 呢件產品。佢溫和地去角質，保持毛孔清潔，對我皮膚好有效。用完皮膚又滑又乾淨，好滿意，會繼續回購。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: It has a soapy texture which might put off some ppl. It’s not the most soapy face wash I had used so it’s fine with me; it does a really good job in oil control and your skin won’t feel dry after washing, comparing with similar products.
reviews.zh: 佢有種梘液嘅質感，可能會嚇親部分人。佢唔係我用過最梘液嘅洗面，所以對我嚟講OK。控油效果好好，而且用完唔會覺得乾，比起同類型產品好好多。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: Me encanta toda la línea aparte de hidratar la pielse se siente muy fresca la mayoría de brotes que tenia de acné se han ido la utilizan dos veces a la semana y tengo resultados excelentes
reviews.zh: 我成條line都好鍾意，除咗幫皮膚保濕之外，感覺好清新，本來有嘅暗瘡大部分都退咗。我一個星期用兩次，效果非常出色。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Foam 100ml
reviews.text: This is a great cleanser for oily acne prone skin. It calmed my break out. Though I don't suggest you use it 2x a day, or even daily as this has exfoliating properties. Don't be fooled by the gentle feel of this cleanser. In the long run, it'll strip your skin and defeat the purpose. I suggest use it 3x a week at most and during your night routine.
reviews.zh: 呢個係油性同暗瘡肌嘅好選擇。佢幫我鎮靜咗爆瘡。雖然我就不建議日日用兩次，甚至日日用，因為佢有去角質成分。唔好畀佢溫和嘅質感呃到你，長遠用會抽乾你皮膚水分，得不償失。我建議一個禮拜最多用3次，加入你嘅晚間程序。
